title: Ultrasonic decoating of solid oxide cell particles for raw material recycling
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,2277-2287
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00025H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Carlo Kaiser, Urs Alexander Peuker
Crushing and sieving of solid oxide cells separates perovskites into the fine fraction. Ultrasonic decoating further purifies coarse particles, enabling an efficient recycling route that supports recovery of valuable raw materials for direct reuse.
